description: This file defines the `AudioBufferProcessor` class, a component responsible for managing, buffering, and synchronizing audio streams from user and bot sources within a larger speech or chat processing pipeline. It handles audio resampling, mixing, stereo interleaving, turn-based audio events, and buffer management, serving as a core part of an audio processing framework.

classes.name: AudioBufferProcessor
classes.description: A class for processing, buffering, and synchronizing audio streams from user and bot sources, supporting mixed and stereo configurations, with event-driven audio data handling and turn-based audio segment management.

methods.name: _process_turn_recording(self, frame: Frame, resampled_audio: Optional[bytes] = None)
methods.description: Manages turn-based audio segments, detecting speaking phases, and triggering relevant events.

methods.name: _call_on_audio_data_handler(self)
methods.description: Invokes event handlers with the current buffered audio segments, both merged and separate tracks.

methods.name: bool _buffer_has_audio(self, buffer: bytearray)
methods.description: Checks whether a given audio buffer contains data.

methods.name: _reset_recording(self)
methods.description: Resets buffers and states related to audio recording sessions.

methods.name: _reset_all_audio_buffers(self)
methods.description: Clears all primary audio buffers for user and bot.

methods.name: _reset_primary_audio_buffers(self)
methods.description: Clears only the main user and bot audio buffers.

methods.name: _reset_turn_audio_buffers(self)
methods.description: Clears buffers dedicated to turn-specific audio segments.

methods.name: _align_track_buffers(self)
methods.description: Pads the shorter audio track with silence to ensure synchronization between tracks.

methods.name: bytes _resample_output_audio(self, frame: OutputAudioRawFrame)
